camel_example: aliyun ossutil api open-meta-query --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --mode 'example-string' --role 'example-string'
description_en: Enables the metadata management feature. After the metadata management feature is enabled, Object Storage Service (OSS) creates a metadata index library for the bucket and builds metadata indexes for all objects in the bucket. After the metadata index library is created, OSS continues to perform near-real-time incremental tracking scans on new objects in the bucket and builds metadata indexes for the incremental objects
description_zh: 开启元数据管理功能。开启元数据管理功能后，OSS会为Bucket创建元数据索引库并为Bucket中的所有文件（Object）建立元数据索引。元数据索引库创建完成后，OSS会继续对Bucket中新增文件进行准实时的增量追踪扫描并为增量文件建立元数据索引
name: OpenMetaQuery
